title: Build Grave Accord and polish multiplayer, visibility and first-run flow
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord's current cooperative game loop has 66 boss identities, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. Offline Solo, public/private waiting rooms, host-only Start, optional passwords, profiles, encounter-boundary saves and authority-written server team records are implemented. Both public and testing share the first-run preset, Tutorial, named shop items, readable health/shield/resources and fixed/random map choices. Testing keeps rehearsal and difficulty-unlock tools.

Online Settings, guides and chat remain personal menus. Only the current host may explicitly Pause/Continue the match; chat and connectivity remain live while simulation/countdowns freeze. Host departure resumes play and transfers controls. End game for everyone is separately confirmed and explains the result without awarding a fake clear. The host can reveal the invitation password beside the code, and password entry has eye buttons. Plaintext stays in private Session memory, outside server state/listings/metadata/saves/application storage. Chat retains drafts until server confirmation, safely retries after reconnect and preserves its accepted C toggle/menu layout.

The current camera follow-up gives tall bosses and survivors space near the edges without removing upper passages. All 66 measured boss poses/references and 172 survivor clips fit the fixed camera across all 36 map/difficulty combinations; actual cursor events share its transform. Brass Toad follows connected clear hops around cover and keeps its detour until the target is visible. Actual encounters reach the upper floor on all 36 combinations, including Baby Ossuary Works. The extra lava circle/marker is removed while painted pit activation and damage remain. The human accepted Pause/Settings staying at the corner during defeat; current camera/lava comparison is pending in testing 5244/public 5245.

Boss clears hold their actual position/floor for five seconds with one sound, preparation text and countdown; 15 bosses have full falls and 51 have final poses. Medic recovery is finite, including Hard30% and Insane1HP self/team recovery, with Hellish none. Regeneration and shield capacity scale with difficulty; Tank/Heavy/Soldier start each fight with100%/50%/15% of allowed shield capacity. Future cap branches, selective blocking, ally bots and story/lore remain deferred ideas. Loading Cancel/Esc, late-callback ownership and useful room errors are verified. Team records retain authority scoring, ties/participants/filtering/paging; test runs and client-submitted scores cannot qualify.

Validation: exact source **6f397a5173c69d1b710d7c02d8772f3a5f5e19b7**, build **2026.10.29-camera-clearance / protocol 43**, passes **869/869/0** locally and in both CI jobs, plus TypeScript, authored content/fifteen locales/native artwork, production build and 71 atlas contracts. [CI 123863615565](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40994266240/job/123863615565) · [CI 123863558310](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40994247787/job/123863558310). [Complete source, logs, failures and limits](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/camera-clearance-2026-10-29). Wiki **57030abda3632dad094ed582d394f409cccfba4c** matches all 18 canonical pages and 34 images plus public responses/hashes. Fresh frozen public 5245/backend 2619 and testing 5244/backend 2618 each pass 33 served hashes and actual protected-room/code/host-start/chat/pause/transfer/end/record checks. No synthetic qualifying score was submitted.

The matching local Windows review uses the same 6f397a5 source and has six passing packaged offline/LAN diagnostics on original, deep extraction and an independent Japanese-path Windows copy. All 1899 files match after native execution on all three copies. The 842941714-byte ZIP has SHA256 d00c2db1ee7859aea9aa49fe362d7325f39f4692fc53864f3a76cbd5b0c23f04. Exact sealed evidence is tracked in [the package review](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/windows-camera-clearance-2026-10-29). Older 6987362 and fe82c7e ZIPs, the b108b5f intermediate, previews, original artwork, failed attempts and raw reports remain preserved.

This remains development work. Human multiplayer/balance, rendered/device/listening/native-language, complete action art, physical second-machine LAN, WAN/endurance/capacity and shared hosted rankings/recovery acceptance remain open. Browser automation is disabled. The older protocol 4 Site and immutable protocol 13 published Windows download are separate. This draft does not merge main, deploy the game, replace a hosted release or submit the contest.
